notes.title: 20241010 Update: Changes to in-game operations
notes.notes:
Some operations in the game have been optimized
1 In-game placement function: Change the material placement operation from drag and drop material to drag-and-drop and drag-and-drop
2. The game Angle of view is changed from the original only up and down rotation to both up and down and left and right rotation (but it is recommended that the rotation Angle not be too large, because the game scene will wear)
3 Added the continuous placement option (in the top right of the materials panel), which allows continuous placement of materials after opening

In the future, the scene will be optimized to match the viewing Angle
